samples.summary: Master-target de-duplication happens on the RAW rel target, so the newly supported root-relative spelling can bypass it
samples.evidence: `orderedMasterTargets` dedups with `seen.has(rel.target)` / `seen.add(rel.target)` (index.ts:287-296) on the unresolved string, and only resolves later in `loadMasterAndLayouts` (index.ts:350). Before this change a `/ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml` target resolved to the bogus `ppt/ppt/slideMasters/...` and was dropped by `readText`; now it resolves successfully, so a deck that references the same master once as `slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml` and once as `/ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml` will load and parse that master twice, pushing its layouts twice into `masterAndLayouts.layouts`. Impact is contained (dedupeLayouts collapses by id, layoutMap keys overwrite) but the work is duplicated and layout ordering can shift. The same raw-string comparison pattern also appears for `pickRelTarget`. Fix: dedupe on `resolveRelsTarget('ppt/presentation.xml', rel.target)`.

samples.summary: `..` segments that climb above the package root are silently swallowed, and a degenerate target can resolve to the empty string
samples.evidence: In the normalization loop `if (seg === '..') stack.pop();` pops an empty stack without error, so `resolveRelsTarget('ppt/slides/slide1.xml', '../../../media/x.png')` yields `media/x.png` and `resolveRelsTarget(p, '/')` yields `''`. The new root-relative branch makes the empty-baseDir case reachable for any `/`-prefixed target, so `''` is now passed to `archive.readText('')` / `readBytes('')`. JSZip returns undefined for those, so callers fall back to their unsupported/skipped paths rather than crashing — a wrong-but-loud result, not a crash — but the malformed target is resolved to a plausible-looking path instead of being rejected.

samples.summary: Root-relative rel targets are still mishandled by the parallel OOXML importers (docs), which were not updated
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/import/docx-importer.ts:40 relsDirFor` simply prefixes the part directory onto the target with no handling for a leading `/`, and `docx-parser.ts:116` reads the raw `Target`. A `.docx` whose rels use the package-root form (`/word/media/image1.png`) — the exact case this PR fixes for pptx — still resolves to `word//word/media/image1.png`-style paths and the image is dropped. sheets (`xlsx-importer.ts:114 normalizeZipPath`) strips empty segments so it happens to tolerate the leading slash. Not introduced by this diff; flagged because the same class of bug remains one package over.
